title: Contains Duplicate
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, return `True` if any value appears **at least twice** in the array, and return `False` if every element is distinct.

### Requirements & Constraints
- An optimal approach uses a hash set to track visited elements in $\mathcal{O}(N)$ average time.
- Early return as soon as the first duplicated value is encountered.

solution:
### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Vectorized, mathematically sound implementation.

### ⚡ Implementation
```python
def contains_duplicate(nums):
    """
    Return True if any value appears at least twice in the array.
    """
    return len(nums) != len(set(nums))
```

### ⏱️ Complexity Analysis
- **Time Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N)$
- **Space Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N)$
